As original software are expensive & found rarely. 7595 views Q. I have a question regarding taxi cabs in Chicago. Is it allowable to tranport drunk passengers? Let me explain you the situation here: During morning shifts(5Am to 5PM) the passengers are mostly those going to office, airport or shopping malls. But during evening shifts, customers are mostly going to Bars/Pubs/strip clubs. There are certain streets which have bars one after the other. Going on those streets means you are going near bars. Also cabbies line up outside famous bars/pubs. If you want to avoid these customers you have to take small streets where you are almost certain of not getting any customers. Then to pick up customers you have to go to office areas which will be very far. After 11PM there is hardly anyone else on the streets other than drunk revelers. Another issue you can consider is that if anyone is trying to flag you down, you cannot refuse them. But that is just a rule and can be conveniently broken. In short avoiding bar areas is feasible but you make 1/3rd of what other people make. 2137 views Q. Tution Fee to teach The Quran 2833 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 58355 Country: India Title: کیا ہم گھر میں ڈکیٹی کے خوف سے گھر کی حفاظت کے لئے ( ہاؤس گارڈ ) کتے رکھ سکتے ہیں؟ Question: کیا ہم گھر میں ڈکیٹی کے خوف سے گھر کی حفاظت کے لئے ( ہاؤس گارڈ ) کتے رکھ سکتے ہیں؟ Answer ID: 58355 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! Fatwa ID: 277-277/Sd=6/1436-U گھر کی حفاظت کے لیے کتا پالنا جائز ہے، قال في الہندیة: ویجب أن یعلم بأن اقتناء الکلب لأجل الحرس جائز شرعًا - وکذلک اقتناوٴہ لحفظ الزرع والماشیة جائز (الفتاوی الہندیة: ۴/۴۱۷،وکذا في باقیات فتاوی رشیدیہ: ص:۳۸۸) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
